headline: US FDA Approves Generic Version of HIV Prevention Drug Lenacapavir
summary: US regulators approved a generic version of the HIV prevention drug lenacapavir, which costs $40 per year, opening the path for distribution across 120 low- and middle-income nations.
why: Approval of low-cost generic preventative treatments expands healthcare access in developing markets and impacts pharmaceutical pricing dynamics for infectious disease therapies.

impacts.name: Pharmaceuticals
impacts.why: Regulatory approval of low-cost generic HIV drugs alters market access and pricing models in emerging economies.
